final: WITH account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount, COUNT(*) as trans_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(trans_count) as avg_trans_per_account FROM account_stats) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.trans_count, a.trans_count / o.avg_trans_per_account as ratio FROM account_stats a CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count o ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
